tasks.title: Synthetic corpus generator, loader, reset
tasks.objective: Deterministic ~40-matter firm with planted conflicts (2-hop subsidiary, declined consult, alias chain, decoys); idempotent UNWIND...MERGE loader; reset function; generator unit tests
acceptance: WHEN the generator runs twice THE SYSTEM SHALL emit identical corpora

tasks.objective: POST /api/intake (extract -> resolve fails-closed -> k<=3 paths + baseline -> matter blocked), GET /api/matters(/id), /api/health; RED-first unit tests for AC-3/AC-4; integration tests (skip without FALKORDB_URL)
